english.title: Goods vehicle operators disc illegible

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: GOODS VEHICLES LICENSING OF OPERATORS REGULATIONS 1995
GOODS VEHICLES LICENSING OF OPERATORS ACT 1995

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of an operator's licence at a time when a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), was specified in the licence, failed to exhibit on that vehicle a disc appropriate to it which was in a legible condition
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 23(3) and 32 of the Goods Vehicles (Licensing of Operators) Regulations 1995 and section 57(9) of the Goods Vehicles (Licensing of Operators) Act 1995.
